prompt:
A breathtaking candid 35mm flash photograph — an intimate waist-up hero portrait of an extraordinarily stunning, top-tier East Asian young woman in a living room, captured straight-on at eye level in an M1 authentic candid lifestyle register.

The woman possesses captivating, idol-tier East Asian facial features with radiant dewy porcelain glass-skin, a delicate V-oval jawline, and soft peachy-pink blush glowing on her cheeks. She has silky, glossy dark espresso hair falling gracefully over her slender shoulders and collarbones, with a few effortless wispy strands framing her lovely temples. Her large, dark almond doe eyes are exceptionally luminous and watery with prominent, adorable aegyo-sal cushions and natural fluttering eyelashes, gazing softly with an enchanting, sweet vulnerability. Her nose is slender, straight, and impeccably refined with a delicate button tip, paired with plump, naturally dewy rose-petal lips with a subtle gloss. She has a slender, graceful frame featuring deep hollowed collarbones and a long swan neck, with an attractive feminine bustline. She wears a chic color-blocked layered camisole tank top: a crisp white square-neck band across the upper chest transitioning into a snug pastel baby-pink ribbed-cotton body with ultra-thin pink shoulder straps, paired with dark washed black jeans. She stands in a relaxed, effortlessly beautiful posture.

The setting is an authentic apartment living room — behind her sits a textured charcoal-blue fabric sofa, an off-white wall displaying a vintage framed artwork with a thin gold frame, and a tall white vertical standing air conditioning unit positioned on the right, providing an unpretentious domestic backdrop that contrasts with her breathtaking beauty.

The lighting is governed by direct on-camera compact flash physics — a crisp, clean burst of frontal light illuminates her glowing face, clear eyes, and the pastel pink knit camisole with radiant clarity, while casting subtle, natural contact shadows of her figure against the wall behind her, evoking a coveted raw flash-snapshot aesthetic.

Captured with a wide-latitude digital cinema look on a fast 35mm lens at wide aperture T1.8, delivering tack-sharp optical focus on her sparkling eyes, eyelashes, skin texture, and ribbed cotton fabric, while naturally softening the sofa and living room background into gentle depth. Daylight film emulation with delicate pastel pinks, deep charcoal blues, authentic warm skin glow, and fine 35mm theatrical grain. Real photographic frame captured on a real compact camera, real flash lighting, real cotton knit camisole, real strikingly beautiful East Asian human subject, real living room interior — no CGI, no heavy artificial makeup, no plastic skin, no AI waxiness, no plain ordinary features, no fake studio lighting.
